note: Whole batch function includes file discovery and loading, per-invocation reference preparation/destruction, six bidirectional queries, all evaluation summaries and quality gates. Three candidates select unchanged real compared coordinates at strides 1/2/4; they are subsets of one source, not independent surveys. Full-f64 parity and excluded first pairs precede five warm-up and alternating timed pairs. Candidate writes, imports, hashing, correctness checks and CLI report serialization are outside clocks. No outliers removed; warmed OS file cache, clocks and scheduling remain uncontrolled. Native capacity is payload, not RSS. No browser/GPU speed claim.
